title: 战争机器

sync.scope: Source statistics tables and available 2026 history; base values

facts: The Battle Machine is the first Hero unlocked in the Builder Base. It requires Builder Hall 5 and 900,000 Builder Elixir to repair.
When deployed, the Battle Machine will start with the ability charged up to level 1. It takes about 40 seconds to charge up to level 3 from the moment the ability is activated.

At level 5, the Battle Machine unlocks the Electric Hammer ability. When used, it is momentarily stunned, regenerates some of its health and does increased damage for its next three attacks. This ability is improved every five levels.
The Battle Machine can currently be upgraded to level 35.
The Battle Machine is coded to have a spring weight of 25 for the purposes of Push Traps and Spring Traps. However, it is immune to them regardless.
At level 15 and higher, its 2nd and 3rd tier of its ability additionally chains lightning between buildings.
